title: Reverse Holo Forretress 114/185 Rare Vivid Voltage Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Forretress card from the Vivid Voltage set of the Pokémon TCG is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection. With its stunning Holo Rare finish and Reverse Holo effect, this Stage 2 Pokémon card is a must-have for any serious collector. 

Featuring the character Forretress and the card number 114/185, this card is a true gem. Its rarity and unique attributes make it a valuable investment for any fan of the Pokémon TCG. Add this card to your collection today and experience the thrill of owning a rare and coveted Forretress card.
